tabs.html:
DeepCool PN850D 850W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

The DeepCool PN850D 850W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is engineered to deliver exceptional stability, efficiency, and power capacity for modern desktop systems. Built with the latest ATX 3.1 standard, this PSU ensures full support for next-generation GPUs through its native 12V-2×6 (16-pin) PCIe connector, making it an excellent choice for gamers, creators, and professionals running demanding hardware.


With its 80 Plus Gold certification, the PN850D guarantees high energy efficiency, reduced power wastage, and improved thermal performance under heavy load. The advanced Full Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC power architecture ensures precise and stable power output, protecting sensitive components and maintaining performance consistency.


The PSU features a 120mm Hydro Bearing fan, designed for quiet and efficient cooling. Its non-modular design includes all essential cables pre-attached, offering reliable connectivity for high-end GPUs, multiple storage drives, and power-hungry CPUs.


Equipped with multiple industrial-grade safety protections including OVP, OCP, UVP, SCP, OPP, and OTP, the DeepCool PN850D ensures long-term hardware safety. Backed by a solid 10-year manufacturer warranty, this PSU delivers excellent value and dependability for high-performance PC builds in Bangladesh.
